content: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) maintains a standard (ISO 216) that defines the A-series paper sizes, where each size is determined by having an aspect ratio equal to the square root of 2 (approximately 1.414), which allows each sheet to be folded in half to produce the next smaller size while maintaining the same proportions.
